Mara at V's explicit direction writes one sealed short offer to Sedgecross wayhouse keeper/sick-tender to read privately to all eleven patients when received: after medically recovered, they are WELCOME to voluntary residence and honest PAID WORK at V's BLACKTHORN HOLD in Crownsunder; no coerced work, no mandatory relocation, and no travel against medical advice; precise ROUTE from Sedgecross go SOUTH on established receiving road to CAER VEYLAN, then WESTBOUND via the legal Tarnford–Caer Veylan Trade Road crossing normal border to CROWNSUNDER, then from TARNFORD along known upland coach road to BLACKTHORN HOLD; on arrival ask for TAMSIN BRACK, acting manager/steward. Route uses REAL established public roads, NOT Hollowdeep or nonexistent river port or instantaneous travel, and there is no claim of a specific safe fare, coach escort or guaranteed checkpoint immunity. No patient's actual decision to move/hire/accept shelter is made by V or DM. Courier quotes ordinary local sealed-letter fee2sp, this modest necessary postage is authorized by V asking to TELL people after departure: V personally pays2sp from purse722gp6sp6cp to722gp4sp6cp, courier accepts item/fee and leaves southward. By DAY286 AFTERNOON after ordinary road travel, courier reaches Sedgecross and delivers the original letter to keeper, who reads/shares the voluntary offer and practical route with the eleven patients in their care. No patient departure, guaranteed all eleven applications, wage payment, occupancy/bed assignment or automatic letter reply ensues; none is compelled to leave. V at road does NOT independently know delivery receipt yet, DM can narrate brief non-secret offscreen result. Because Blackthorn existing staff lodging and quarry/timber operations are verified but eleven vacancies are NOT, Tamsin must assess each future applicant's skills, actual rooms, legitimate salaries and safe needs before assignment. Blackthorn receives a new player-approved OFFER policy, NOT new employees/payroll or immediate building spending. V has standing one-daily V↔Tamsin matched Sending Stone routine delegation, so at DAY285~17:25 use available shared one-per-dawn charge to notify her with max25 words exactly: 'Survivors may seek Blackthorn for housing and paid work. Please receive voluntary applicants, assess their needs, arrange suitable jobs and lodging, protect their privacy.' (24 words). Tamsin independently replies via same pair within one25-word reply: 'I'll welcome them. Quarry, timber, repairs, and other work can use willing hands. I'll assess skills and beds before promising individual assignments.' (22 words), no automatic acceptance that all eleven can lodge/work immediately, no salary quote or renovations, steward acts within standing management authority when applicants appear. No Kestrel authorizations or secret medical information sent with this public hospitality offer, the keeper needs not know broader politics.
